facts.fact: Mozambique's education ministry coordinating council positively appraised a proposed 19-article, four-chapter text of guidelines on AI use in schools (excluding higher education), which is still to be refined before being formalised as a Joint Ministerial Diploma with the labour, gender and social action ministry.

systems.system: Directrizes para o uso de Inteligência Artificial nas escolas

facts.fact: Mozambique's education ministry coordinating council reviewed favourably a draft of 19-article guidelines on AI use in schools, raised by concerns over academic integrity and personal data protection, still to be formalised by a joint ministerial diploma and not yet in force.
facts.system: directrizes para o uso de Inteligencia Artificial nas escolas

MOZ.note: Draft guidelines are a rule on AI in schools; no government AI system in use or piloted is stated.
Guidelines only; no AI tool working in a public education system is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in the country stated.
Personal data protection is named only as a concern behind the AI guidelines; no general law stated.
Nothing on school learner records or an EMIS.
